name: callguard-aws-connect-bridge
description: Lambda that bridges an Amazon Connect Kinesis Video Stream to CallGuard's live scoring WebSocket endpoint.

scripts.check: node --check src/index.js && node --check src/kvs-consumer.js && node --check src/pcm-mixer.js && node --check src/callguard-client.js && node --check src/config.js
scripts.build: rm -rf build bridge.zip && mkdir build && cp -R src package.json build/ && cd build && npm install --omit=dev --no-audit --no-fund && zip -r ../bridge.zip . -x '*.git*' && cd .. && rm -rf build
